import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Adjust prices for splits
    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors.cumprod()
    
    # Initialize weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=prices.index, columns=prices.columns)
    
    # Define the lookback period
    lookback = 20
    
    # Iterate over each row starting from the 21st row
    for i in range(lookback, len(prices)):
        # Calculate the returns for the last 20 days
        returns = adjusted_prices.iloc[i-lookback:i].pct_change().dropna()
        
        # Calculate the sample standard deviation of the returns
        std_dev = returns.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(252)
        
        # Calculate the momentum signal
        momentum_signal = (adjusted_prices.iloc[i] / adjusted_prices.iloc[i-lookback] - 1).apply(np.sign)
        
        # Calculate the target volatility
        target_volatility = 0.10 / std_dev
        
        # Cap the target volatility at 1
        target_volatility = target_volatility.clip(upper=1)
        
        # Calculate the weights
        raw_weights = momentum_signal * target_volatility / 4
        
        # Assign the weights to the current row
        weights.iloc[i] = raw_weights
    
    return weights
